access.retrieval: Connected GitHub explicit-ref file reads and complete recursive Git tree

review_semantics.read_counts: Counts are de-duplicated by original repository path. Full text, full structured data, and partial-only review are reported separately. Full-file coverage does not claim exhaustive correctness verification of every code path.
review_semantics.line_ranges: One-based inclusive source lines; the final unterminated line is counted. Every reviewer extent is preserved, even when another reviewer read the whole file.
review_semantics.data_review: The pilot TSV was fully parsed as data; its duplicated case prose was reviewed through the complete pilot README. This is distinguished from an independent full text read of the TSV.
review_semantics.execution: Static source/data review only. No downloaded repository artifact, import, test, build, analyzer, or product CLI was executed.
review_semantics.tree_scope: The recursive tree establishes repository membership. Blobs absent from this inventory are not claimed as read.

verification.method: Compute SHA-1 over the Git blob header (blob, space, decimal byte length, NUL) followed by exact evidence bytes; compare with the pinned recursive tree and every reviewer manifest SHA claim. Byte sizes are also compared.

reviews.read_extent: sections CLI/process, scan/API index, metrics, headless reporting, compare, dataflow (lines 1-164 and 293-350)
full data parse of header and all 729 cases; schema, field completeness, row tallies, first/last rows inspected; individual case prose reviewed through the complete equivalent pilot README

data_review.limitation: Full structured-data review; do not interpret this as separate line-by-line prose reading of the duplicated TSV evidence.

reviews.read_extent: partial text ranges listed; whole-file rg for aggregation/null/rounding symbols
partial text ranges listed; whole-file rg for ranking/rounding/projection symbols
